candidate_families.architecture_summary: Retain the generic schema and exact runtime contract while strengthening only provider instructions and reference presentation.
candidate_families.problem_addressed: Provider failure to copy the authorized structural identifier.
candidate_families.core_idea: Use natural-language instruction as the sole invocation-specific constraint.
candidate_families.expected_production_impact: Reference semantics and runtime remain unchanged; provider input wording changes.
candidate_families.expected_benchmark_impact: Uncertain because the frozen prompt already states exact-copy requirements and produced 0 exact references in 24 trials.

candidate_families.architecture_summary: Project an invocation-specific strict output schema whose allowed component branches, exact reference constants, and cardinality are derived from the already-authorized target set.
candidate_families.problem_addressed: The static schema accepts structural identifiers outside the invocation-authorized set.
candidate_families.core_idea: Make the provider-visible structural language equal to the authorization language before the single request.
candidate_families.production_boundary: Provider adapter request projection and schema construction.
candidate_families.expected_production_impact: Provider output is constrained earlier; DTO, registry, authorization, reconstruction, runtime, and gateway remain fail-closed and unchanged.
candidate_families.expected_benchmark_impact: Eliminates schema-valid unknown and unauthorized references by construction while preserving measurement of other output failures.

candidate_families.architecture_summary: Transmit short invocation-owned handles and deterministically map returned handles to canonical references before authorization.
candidate_families.problem_addressed: Provider generation of semantically suggestive but incorrect structural identifiers.
candidate_families.core_idea: Separate provider-facing identifiers from canonical domain references.
candidate_families.production_boundary: Projection, provider DTO/schema, handle registry, and reconstruction adapter.
candidate_families.expected_production_impact: Adds a second reference representation and mapping contract.
candidate_families.expected_benchmark_impact: Likely high compliance when handles are enum-constrained, but requires new mapping-specific failure metrics.

candidate_families.architecture_summary: Remove provider-authored references and bind returned patch slots deterministically to the ordered authorized target list.
candidate_families.problem_addressed: Provider cannot reliably emit canonical identifiers.
candidate_families.core_idea: Move reference ownership entirely to runtime and make provider output positional.
candidate_families.production_boundary: Provider DTO/schema and deterministic reconstruction input mapping.
candidate_families.expected_production_impact: Canonical references are never provider-authored, but ordering/cardinality becomes security-critical.
candidate_families.expected_benchmark_impact: Reference-string failures disappear; missing, extra, or reordered slots become the new measured contract failures.

candidate_families.architecture_summary: Constrain schema references to every reference known in the source episode.
candidate_families.elimination_reason: It can prevent unknown references but still permits the 17 observed unauthorized-reference scenarios; C2 narrows the same mechanism to the exact authorized set without weakening any guarantee.

candidate_families.architecture_summary: Normalize, alias, infer, or fuzzily match provider references after response.
candidate_families.elimination_reason: It weakens exact authorization, creates spoofing/confusion risk, and makes accepted mappings dependent on heuristics rather than the frozen deterministic contract.

candidate_families.architecture_summary: Issue a second provider request to repair invalid references.
candidate_families.elimination_reason: It violates the mandatory single-provider-request guarantee and introduces retry-like operational uncertainty.

scale.5: Directly preserves or strengthens the criterion with low residual risk

evaluation_method.weighting: All mandatory criteria are equally weighted.

evaluation_matrix.evidence: The prompt already demands exact copying, yet Part 7C.1 produced no exact authorized reference in 24 responses.
It closes the exact static-schema gap identified in Part 7D and measured in Part 7C.1 before unchanged authorization runs.
Enum-constrained handles can prevent free generation, but add a second identity system not required by the observed failure.
It removes provider reference generation but makes order/cardinality authoritative and changes DTO and reconstruction ownership.

C1_PROMPT_ONLY.maintenance_implications: Prompt behavior must be revalidated across models and prompt revisions.
C1_PROMPT_ONLY.extensibility_implications: Portable, but every provider remains dependent on natural-language adherence.

risks_reduced: missing branches caused by generic union choice
risks_introduced: schema projection defect could reject request preflight

C2_DYNAMIC_EXACT_SCHEMA.extensibility_implications: Each provider adapter can express the same neutral authorized set using its native constrained-output mechanism.

C4_ORDERED_PATCH_SLOTS.extensibility_implications: Provider-portable but less self-describing for new component types.

C1_PROMPT_ONLY.benchmark_reproducibility: Prompt version changes require a new baseline

C2_DYNAMIC_EXACT_SCHEMA.containment: Preflight abort; unchanged authorization remains the final guard
C2_DYNAMIC_EXACT_SCHEMA.recovery: Rollback schema projector/version without data migration
C2_DYNAMIC_EXACT_SCHEMA.authorization_impact: Strengthens early alignment; does not weaken final authorization

C3_OPAQUE_HANDLES.visibility: New handle diagnostics plus existing authorization
C3_OPAQUE_HANDLES.detectability: Schema/preflight for allowed handles; response time for returned values
C3_OPAQUE_HANDLES.authorization_impact: Requires proof that mapped canonical reference was invocation-authorized

C4_ORDERED_PATCH_SLOTS.containment: Fail closed before binding and reconstruction
C4_ORDERED_PATCH_SLOTS.authorization_impact: Authorization shifts from explicit identity to validated position
C4_ORDERED_PATCH_SLOTS.benchmark_reproducibility: Reference metrics must be replaced by slot-alignment metrics

security_analysis.C1_PROMPT_ONLY: Authorization stays exact, but contract ambiguity and spoof/confusion exposure remain at the provider boundary.
security_analysis.C2_DYNAMIC_EXACT_SCHEMA: Exact allowed constants minimize spoofing and confusion; unchanged authorization provides defense in depth; no new privilege path is introduced.
security_analysis.C3_OPAQUE_HANDLES: Handles are capability-like values and must be invocation-scoped; mapping bugs create a new privilege-confusion surface.
security_analysis.C4_ORDERED_PATCH_SLOTS: No reference spoofing is possible, but position confusion can bind valid prose to the wrong authorized target unless count, order, and type are all fail-closed.

C1_PROMPT_ONLY.testing: prompt contract, privacy, and provider benchmark

C2_DYNAMIC_EXACT_SCHEMA.backward_compatibility: DTO and runtime compatible; static schema fingerprint superseded by a versioned projection fingerprint strategy
C2_DYNAMIC_EXACT_SCHEMA.testing: all target types, multi-target cardinality, DTO parity, invalid projection preflight, architecture boundaries, provider benchmark
C2_DYNAMIC_EXACT_SCHEMA.documentation: schema ownership, fingerprint semantics, provider capability mapping

C3_OPAQUE_HANDLES.testing: handle uniqueness, scope, mapping lineage, DTO, authorization, all providers

C4_ORDERED_PATCH_SLOTS.testing: order, cardinality, shape, multi-target binding, authorization equivalence

dominance_analysis.reason: C2 uses the same schema mechanism but excludes both unknown and unauthorized values rather than only unknown values.

Both require invocation-specific constrained values and have equal expected compliance; C2 preserves one canonical identity and avoids DTO, mapping, diagnostics, and migration costs introduced by handles.

preferred_candidate.why: It directly closes the measured provider-schema/authorization language gap at the earliest boundary while retaining canonical reference ownership and every deterministic runtime guard.
implementation_prerequisites: freeze an invocation-specific schema projection contract
define stable base-schema and projected-schema fingerprint semantics
prove DTO parity for every component branch
prove exact reference constants and item cardinality for single and multi-target invocations
retain unchanged final authorization and reconstruction
add provider-capability abstraction for constrained reference sets
